design.execution: rides GPU/provider lanes (fork training + vLLM serving); the harness never dispatches — state admitted_design_only until executed results return records
design.replication: 4 tasks x 12 cells = 48 runs, one observation per cell per task
design.type: full factorial (6 strategies x 2 verifiers), generated by scripts/speculators/evaluate.py build_plan
design.unit_of_observation: one executed run (one task under one cell) = one results.jsonl row

hypothesis.predeclared_threshold: selection requires a lossless cell with acceptance_rate >= 0.50 and mean_speedup >= 1.20, by a margin >= 0.10 mean speedup over the runner-up qualified cell
hypothesis.statement: At least one speculative strategy beats verifier-only decoding by >= 1.20x mean speedup at >= 0.50 acceptance while remaining lossless (outputs identical to verifier-only); block/parallel drafting (dflash, dspark, peagle) beats sequential eagle3 on mean accepted length.

outcomes.primary: mean speedup vs the run's own baseline timing (baseline_elapsed_ms / elapsed_ms)
secondary: lossless_violations = runs with output_match != true (any violation disqualifies the cell)

tasks.prompt: Write a Python function that returns the nth Fibonacci number in O(n) time, with a docstring.
Explain speculative decoding to a new engineer in three short paragraphs.
A train travels 120 km in 1.5 hours, then 80 km in 0.5 hours. Compute its average speed and show the steps.
From the text 'The meeting moved to 2026-11-04 at 14:30 UTC in Room B.' extract date, time, timezone and room as JSON.
